notices.title: Web MCP Bridge (Fork) 1.7.0
notices.message: Fixed: stale replies being re-sent (echo), messages not going out (now 3 automatic retries), false unreadable-JSON notices, and old bridges staying alive. New: JSON editor to add MCPs, configurable response delay, global start/stop/restart button, and Rescan button. Fixed: Allow always / Run buttons being cut off.

notices.title: Web MCP Bridge (Fork) 1.5.0
notices.message: New version with fixes for DeepSeek, JSON fixes, and a design change. Thanks for using the extension.
